# P&L Check

> P&L Check — open-source protocol. You collect facts, reconcile profit with cash, prepare a decision brief. Russian below English in README. Apache-2.0, v0.4.0.

## Documentation
- [README](./README.md): English first, Russian second, install, quick start, battle test, JSON-LD
- [SKILL.md](./skills/pnl-check/SKILL.md): Portable skill (facts, reconciliation, brief, safety rails)
- [Battle test](./examples/pnl-battle-2026-09-16.md): Real run on market data
- [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history
- [Templates](./templates/): context_questionnaire, pnl_structure.csv, data_gap_report
